title: Raptors' Barnes ruled out vs. Celtics; Quickley, Murray-Boyles questionable
text:
Raptors' Barnes ruled out vs. Celtics; Quickley, Murray-Boyles questionable - Sportsnet.ca 
 Loading... Raptors' Barnes ruled out vs. Celtics; Quickley, Murray-Boyles questionable
 Sportsnet Staff @Sportsnet November 10, 2026 - 5:00pm Toronto Raptors forward Scottie Barnes (4) in the second half of an NBA basketball game Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026, in Denver. (David Zalubowski/AP) 
 The Toronto Raptors will once again be shorthanded. 
 Scottie Barnes has been ruled out of Wednesday's game against the Boston Celtics and will miss his third straight game with a left adductor/groin injury. 
 Immanuel Quickley , who has missed two games himself, is listed as questionable with right hamstring tightness. 
 An all-star last season, Barnes appeared to be labouring and favouring his hip during the third quarter in last Wednesday's loss to the Denver Nuggets.
 Barnes, 25, has averaged 23.5 points, 7.6 rebounds, 5.1 assists and 2.3 steals in 33.3 minutes over eight games this season.
 It's unclear how or when Quickley suffered the injury, but he played 32 minutes in that same game.
 The 27-year-old is averaging 17.4 points, 3.5 rebounds, 5.8 assists and 31.8 minutes in eight games.
 Collin Murray-Boyles , who missed Monday's game against Memphis, is also listed as questionable with an illness, as is Trayce Jackson-Davis. 
 Star wing Kawhi Leonard also remains out while undergoing the return-to-play process after receiving treatment for left knee swelling. He will be out at least one more week.
